verdict.why: Node.js compatibility is now detected from the compatibility date (2026-08-04+) without the flag, changing bundler polyfills and process.env handling.

draft.detail: As of compatibility date 2026-08-04, wrangler treats nodejs_compat as enabled by default; previously only when the flag was listed explicitly

test.error: FAIL: compatibility_date 2026-08-04 without a flag is bundled as if nodejs_compat were off

source.quote: As of compatibility date `2026-08-04`, workerd enables the `nodejs_compat` and `nodejs_compat_v2` compatibility flags by default. Previously these tools only treated Node.js compatibility as enabled when one of those flags was listed explicitly
